applies_to: held-out sagas S02 and S07, coded by an independent agent that does not receive these predictions
derived_from: first-coder codes for the 94 derivation attempts in S01, S03-S06, S08, S09, S11, S13-S16 (before second-coder agreement)

predictions.rule: Among held-out non-terminal attempts, primary wrong_diagnosis + incomplete_fix is less than half.
Among held-out non-terminal attempts, primary narrower_scope + new_defect + delivery_failure + scope_decision is at least half.
At most one held-out attempt has primary wrong_diagnosis.
S02 has at least one attempt with delivery_failure as primary or flag.
dod_explicit = yes in at most 25% of held-out attempts.
Among held-out non-terminal attempts with workload_match in {matched, weaker, different}, weaker + different >= matched.
verification_failure is primary in at most 25% of held-out non-terminal attempts.

scoring: Each rule scored pass/fail on the independent coder's codes. A non-terminal attempt is any attempt whose primary code is not terminal_*. If a held-out saga fails I3 under the independent coder, its attempts are still scored and the failure is reported.
